# Brandex — Technical Profile & Knowledge Graph
> Digital Systems & Infrastructure Engineering Company based in Bangalore, India.
> Official Website: https://brandex-official.vercel.app

Brandex designs, develops, and deploys high-performance web applications, cloud infrastructure, smart classroom LMS portals, and automated business workflows.

## Core Engineering Capabilities
- **Bespoke Web Platform Engineering**: Sub-second page loads, custom React/TypeScript architectures, edge CDN routing, zero vendor lock-in, and 100% client source code IP.
- **Enterprise Automation & Cloud Architecture**: Event-driven pipelines, automated webhook integrations, PostgreSQL database scaling, and distributed business systems.
- **Brandex Education Platform**: State Syllabus (KSEEB Classes 6 to 10) digital classroom LMS, smartboard video lessons, and real-time formative quizzes.
- **Brandex Builder Community**: 1,400+ Bangalore software engineers and students collaborating on open-source repositories, developer sprints, and technical bootcamps.

## Production Case Studies & Impact Metrics
- **Amrutam 1980 (Heritage Retail & QSR)**: +340% mobile order growth, sub-100ms multi-location checkout, real-time inventory reconciliation. URL: https://brandex-official.vercel.app/case-studies/amrutam-1980
- **Algorithmic FinTech Trading Terminal**: Under 18ms latency globally, WebSockets real-time price feeds, TimescaleDB microservice architecture. URL: https://brandex-official.vercel.app/case-studies/fintech-trading-terminal
- **Retail Multi-Outlet Inventory Sync Engine**: 40+ hours saved weekly by automating manual cross-warehouse reconciliation via webhook queues. URL: https://brandex-official.vercel.app/case-studies/retail-inventory-automation
- **Geniusphere School Initiative**: Foundation digital labs deployed to over 180+ secondary school students across Karnataka State syllabus. URL: https://brandex-official.vercel.app/education

## Published Technical Editorials & Engineering Guides
- **Sub-Second Web Architecture (2026 Guide)**: Analysis of Time To First Byte (TTFB), edge CDN rendering, React hydration optimization, and killing template bloat. URL: https://brandex-official.vercel.app/blog/sub-second-web-architecture-2026
- **Eliminating the 30% Platform Tax Through Client IP Ownership**: How bespoke architecture eliminates recurring SaaS subscription fees. URL: https://brandex-official.vercel.app/blog/zero-platform-tax-client-ip
- **Automating 40 Hours of Manual Operations Weekly**: Technical deep-dive into event-driven webhook pipelines, idempotent retries, and data synchronization. URL: https://brandex-official.vercel.app/blog/automating-40-hours-business-workflows

## Technical Standards & SLAs
- **Global Time To First Byte (TTFB)**: Under 18ms on edge CDN
- **Lighthouse Core Web Vitals**: 95+ Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, SEO
- **Code Ownership**: 100% Client Source Code & Architecture IP transferred on delivery
- **Stack**: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vite, TailwindCSS, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Cloudflare Workers, Three.js
